privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1.title: 1. Introduction
privacy.section1.content: This Privacy Policy sets out the rules for processing and protecting the personal data of users of the website {{url}}. The data controller is Pawel Lipowczan, who can be contacted at the email address: {{email}}.
privacy.section2.title: 2. Types of Data Collected
privacy.section2.intro: While using the website, we may collect the following data:
privacy.section2.item1: Contact form data (full name, email address, subject and message) - provided voluntarily
privacy.section2.item2: Email address given when joining the LLM Wiki list - provided voluntarily
privacy.section2.item3: Details given when booking a consultation in the Zencal calendar - provided voluntarily
privacy.section2.item4: Technical data (IP address, browser type, operating system, address of the page visited) - collected automatically
privacy.section2.item5: Cookies and browser storage - details in the Cookie Policy
privacy.section3.title: 3. Purpose of Data Processing
privacy.section3.intro: Personal data is processed for the purpose of:
privacy.section3.item1: Responding to inquiries submitted via the contact form
privacy.section3.item2: Arranging and holding a consultation booked in the calendar
privacy.section3.item3: Sending messages about the LLM Wiki template and course to people who joined the list
privacy.section3.item4: Analyzing website traffic and optimizing its performance
privacy.section4.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
privacy.section4.intro: Data processing is carried out on the basis of:
privacy.section4.item2: Legitimate interest of the controller (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR)
privacy.section5.title: 5. Data Retention Period
privacy.section5.content: Personal data is retained for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, but no longer than the period required by law or until the user withdraws consent.
privacy.section6.title: 6. User Rights (GDPR)
privacy.section6.intro: In accordance with the GDPR, the user has the right to:
privacy.section6.item3: Erasure of data (right to be forgotten)
privacy.section6.item8: Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority
privacy.section7.title: 7. Sharing of Personal Data
privacy.section7.intro: Data is passed to these service providers:
privacy.section7.item1: Vercel - website hosting (IP address and technical data of every request) and cookieless traffic and performance measurement
privacy.section7.item2: Google - Google Analytics, only after consent to analytics cookies
privacy.section7.item3: Formspree - contact form handling (contact details and message)
privacy.section7.item4: Resend - LLM Wiki mailing list (email address)
privacy.section7.item5: Zencal - consultation booking calendar (details given when booking). The widget loads a profile picture from a DigitalOcean server.
privacy.section7.item6: Sentry - reports the browser sends when the site tries to load a resource outside its list of allowed sources (page and resource address, browser type, IP address)
privacy.section7.footer: Some providers (Vercel, Google, Formspree, Resend) operate in the United States, so data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area.
privacy.section8.title: 8. Data Security
privacy.section8.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, modification, unauthorized disclosure, or access.
privacy.section9.title: 9. Contact
privacy.section9.content: For matters related to the processing of personal data and the exercise of rights under the GDPR, please contact us at the email address:
privacy.section10.title: 10. Changes to the Privacy Policy
privacy.section10.content: We reserve the right to make changes to this Privacy Policy. Any changes will be communicated by updating the date of the last modification.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: Cookie Policy
cookies.section1.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
cookies.section1.content: Cookies are small text files stored on the user's device while browsing a website. Cookies allow the website to recognize the user's device and customize the content to their preferences.
cookies.section1.storage: Browser storage (localStorage and sessionStorage) works in a similar way: the site can save short pieces of information on your device there. This policy covers both.
cookies.section2.title: 2. What Do We Store on Your Device?
cookies.section2.intro: The following information may end up on your device:
cookies.section2.preferences.title: Your Consent Choice and Language
cookies.section2.preferences.content: The site saves your answer to the cookie notice (cookieConsent) and the site language (i18nextLng) in browser storage. That way it does not ask again and shows the site in your language. These are not cookies, and your browser does not send them to any server. They stay until you delete them. Withdrawing consent deletes the saved choice.
cookies.section2.analytics.title: Analytics Cookies (Google Analytics)
cookies.section2.analytics.content: They appear only if you click "Accept". Google Analytics then stores the _ga and _ga_7L4PXG8E8Z cookies. They tell repeat visits from the same browser apart and keep track of the current session. According to Google's documentation, they expire after 2 years by default.
cookies.section2.booking.title: Booking Calendar (Zencal)
cookies.section2.booking.content: It loads only when you open the consultation booking window. The Zencal widget then saves the data the calendar needs to work in browser storage. Zencal describes the details in its privacy policy.
cookies.section2.marketing.title: Marketing Cookies
cookies.section2.marketing.content: We do not use marketing or advertising cookies.
cookies.section3.title: 3. Third-Party Services
cookies.section3.intro: The website uses services from these providers:
cookies.section3.item1.label: Vercel
cookies.section3.item1.text: - website hosting plus traffic and page-speed measurement (Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights). The measurement runs for every visitor and sets no cookies.
cookies.section3.item2.label: Google Analytics
cookies.section3.item2.text: - website traffic analysis, only after you click "Accept".
cookies.section3.item3.label: Zencal
cookies.section3.item3.text: - consultation booking calendar, loaded when you open the booking window.
cookies.section3.footer: These providers process data in accordance with their own privacy policies. The Privacy Policy lists every recipient of data.
cookies.section4.title: 4. Managing Cookies
cookies.section4.intro: Users can control and manage cookies in various ways:
cookies.section4.browser.title: Browser Settings
cookies.section4.browser.intro: Most browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can change these settings:
cookies.section4.browser.chrome: Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies
cookies.section4.delete.title: Deleting Cookies
cookies.section4.delete.content: You can delete cookies stored on your device at any time through your browser settings. Please note, however, that deleting cookies may affect the functionality of the website. The same settings also let you clear data saved in browser storage.
cookies.section5.title: 5. Consent to Cookies
cookies.section5.content: We only start Google Analytics once you click "Accept" in the cookie notice. Clicking "Reject" or dismissing the notice means no consent. Google Analytics will not load and will not store any cookies. Cookieless measurement runs whatever you choose: Vercel Web Analytics counts page views and Speed Insights measures how fast pages load. They store no cookies and no data in browser storage. According to Vercel's documentation, repeat views are recognised by a hash (a string computed from the request data). Vercel discards it after 24 hours, and we only see aggregate statistics. You can withdraw consent at any time with the button below. The button does not remove cookies Google has already stored. Those expire on their own, or you can clear them in your browser settings.
cookies.section5.status.none: Your current choice: no decision yet
cookies.section5.withdrawAria: Withdraw Google Analytics consent and reload the page
cookies.section6.title: 6. Policy Updates
cookies.section6.content: We may periodically update this Cookie Policy. Any changes will be published on this page with an updated "Last updated" date.

cookies.section7.content: For more information about cookies, please visit:
